facilities.name: Annadanam (Free Meals)
facilities.description: The temple provides free lunch daily to all visiting pilgrims from 11:30 AM to 2:30 PM at the Annadanam hall.

facilities.name: Devasthanam Satralu
facilities.description: Clean and budget-friendly guest houses managed by the temple administration.

facilities.name: Haritha Hotel Edupayala
facilities.description: Telangana Tourism (TSTDC) operates AC and Non-AC guest rooms and cottages near the temple site.

facilities.name: Local Stalls
facilities.description: Small eateries and tiffin centers serving South Indian meals are located near the guest houses.

facilities.name: Kalyana Katta (Tonsure)
facilities.description: Dedicated areas located near the river ghats for traditional hair offerings.

facilities.name: Vehicle Puja
facilities.description: Performed at the temple entrance for safety and blessings.

facilities.name: Pure Vegetarian Dining Network
facilities.description: At the foothills, several local family-run eateries and community kitchens serve traditional, pure vegetarian meals (without onion and garlic/Sattvic options) tailored specifically for devotees observing fasts or performing sacred rituals.

facilities.name: Public Toilets
facilities.description: Standard public toilet facilities are provided by the temple board near the main entrance gates, kalyana katta, and near the bathing ghats.

facilities.name: Drinking Water Facilities
facilities.description: Reverse Osmosis (RO) purified drinking water stations are installed at key points, including the queue lines, temple entrance, and Devasthanam Satralu.

facilities.name: Parking Areas
facilities.description: Large open-air parking lots are maintained by the temple administration near the main entrance. Separate parking fees apply during major festivals (₹50 for two-wheelers, ₹200 for cars/four-wheelers).

facilities.name: First-Aid Counter / Medical Emergencies
facilities.description: A basic first-aid counter is active in the temple administrative block during general darshan hours.

facilities.name: Temple Control Room / Public Address System
facilities.description: Announcements can be made from the Temple Control Room/Administrative Office near the main entrance.
